title: fix(console): on a phone the account menu stays on the screen in every language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6okWxYPWAsooBsJoAhnT1u)_

Fixes #36041

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 手机上(768 像素以下)打开右上角头像菜单:以前德、法、俄、西、葡语等界面下菜单比屏幕宽、语言按钮被挤出屏幕右侧点不到;现在菜单不超出屏幕、长句自动换行,语言列表在按钮下方(放不下时在上方)完整打开;电脑宽屏不变。
- 属于手机端外壳的体验修复,替用德语等长文案语言、且浏览器通知被拦截或不支持(如苹果手机浏览器)的手机用户解决。
- 出错的话最多是手机上头像菜单显示得窄一些或换行多一些,不影响数据;只改了一处样式,可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

On a phone the account (avatar) menu sized itself to its longest line, with no width cap. The longest line is the desktop-notification hint, shown whenever notifications are blocked or the browser has no Notification API (Safari on iPhone outside an installed web app). At 375 px with that hint showing, the menu was wider than the screen in seven of the eleven interface languages, and in German, French, Russian, Spanish and Portuguese the Language control sat off the right edge, so the language list could not be opened at all (readings below).

- `AccountMenu.tsx`: the menu content gains `max-md:max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]`, the screen less a 1 rem gutter on each side, below `md` only. Long lines now wrap and keep their full text (no truncation, so nothing needs a `title`).
- From 768 px up nothing changes: the cap is `max-md:`-scoped, and the sidebar-foot trigger from #36187 keeps its placement (above, aligned to the start).

**Measured premises (Zone 2 of the dispatch):**

1. The overflowing element is the menu content; the language control overflowed only as a passenger, because it sits inside the menu row.
2. `LocaleSwitcher` is not a side-opening sub-menu: it is its own dropdown anchored to the globe button, opening below it (`data-side=bottom`) and flipping above where only that fits (it does with two organizations listed). Once the globe is back on screen, the list opens on screen in all eleven languages with all eleven rows reachable, so card item 2 is met without changing `LocaleSwitcher`. It is shared with the sign-in page footer (`AuthFooter.tsx`), and this PR leaves it untouched; it already caps its own width at `min(20rem, 100vw - 2rem)`.
3. The cap is local to this menu. The shared `DropdownMenuContent` lives in `packages/components/src/ui/`, which is the upstream no-touch zone, and changing it would change every dropdown; `@object-ui/components` is not touched.

The one true sub-menu in this menu, the organization switcher, already renders as inline rows on a phone (`usePhoneViewport` in `WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx`); measured with two organizations, it stays inside the capped menu.

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AccountMenu.tsx`, the `DropdownMenuContent` className: the whole behaviour change.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AccountMenu.phoneWidth-36041.test.tsx`: the new pins.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.phoneTargets-29075.test.tsx`: its source pin of the same className, updated.

## Tests

New file `AccountMenu.phoneWidth-36041.test.tsx` (real Radix menus, real German i18n pack, no component mocks):

- the opened account menu carries the phone-only cap, and no unscoped `max-w-*` (desktop unchanged);
- the language list opens below or above the globe, never to a side, with one row per platform locale;
- each of the eleven rows picks its language (`document.documentElement.lang` after each pick equals the full tag set);
- CONTROL: the sidebar trigger's menu keeps `data-side=top`, `data-align=start`.

jsdom has no layout, so the cap pin is a class assertion; the layout itself is the browser readings below. `AppHeader.phoneTargets-29075.test.tsx` pinned the old className literally and now pins the new one.

Ablation, one run (fix committed first, mutation by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob):


The placement, pick-every-language and desktop-control pins stay green under the ablation, as they should: they pin behaviour the cap does not change in jsdom.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Browser readings are from a throwaway Vite entry (not committed) that mounts the real `AccountMenu` from `ui/` source with stub auth and metadata contexts, the real i18n packs and the console's own CSS, in Chromium at 375 x 812. The full app was not booted: the container has 4 cores shared with other agents and the showcase closure plus the Console build did not fit the session. The harness source is in the evidence folder.
- The hint state matters: with notification permission at its default (desktop Chromium), German fits at 272 px and the card's overflow does not show; it shows with permission `denied` (all seven languages) or with no Notification API (German at 374 of 375 px). The readings below use `denied`.
- Arabic: the harness shows the menu's rows laid out left-to-right under an RTL document. It fits before and after (0 to 322 px) and this PR does not change it; whether the real Console mirrors the menu was not measured here.

## Verification

Two-minute check: on a phone (or devtools at 375 px), set the interface to German, block notifications for the site, open the avatar menu: the menu stays inside the screen, the notification hint wraps onto two lines, and tapping the globe opens the language list under it with all eleven languages.
